supporting_news.title: FPIs withdraw Rs 48,056 cr from equities in Oct so far amid elevated crude oil prices
supporting_news.summary: Foreign investors withdrew significant funds from Indian equities in October amid concerns over inflation and crude oil prices. Despite this, there were signs of moderation in selling with two days of net buying. The overall FPI outflows from equities in 2026 have reached notable levels compared to previous years. Market participants are closely monitoring upcoming macroeconomic developments including US GDP data.
